final_claim.narrative: A genuine time-respecting cascade exists: 318->1528 (t=33570) -> 56 (33810) -> 602 (33995) -> 149 (34220) -> 480 (34472). All four inter-hop waits (240, 185, 225, 252) are well under the 600-unit limit, and the whole chain is compressed into ~900 time units inside a 38k-unit observation window, so it is not an artifact of a long permissive interval. Confounder checks: (a) the relay nodes are not hubs — 1528, 602, 149 and 56 have only 4, 5, 9 and 14 events respectively, far below the top-activity nodes (733 with 340 events, step_08), so the path is not manufactured by high-traffic broadcasters; (b) each critical link is a single, non-repeated directed event (318->1528 and 149->480 each occur exactly once, in the correct direction), and the six chain nodes together generate only 5 events in [33500,34500] — precisely the cascade itself, with no surrounding noise; (c) directionality/ordering matters here, since the reverse traversal 480->318 fails entirely under the same 600-unit rule, ruling out a mere ignore-time static connection; (d) tightening max_wait to 150 breaks reachability, confirming the 600-unit budget is doing real work rather than the graph being trivially saturated (repeat ratio 0.019, 8136 events over 1960 nodes = sparse). Only one distinct time-respecting route was recoverable, so the cascade is real but narrow — a single fragile chain rather than a robust multi-path diffusion, which is why confidence is 0.82 rather than higher.
